evals.prompt: 我最近收到一份新工作 offer，薪资涨 40% 但要去 996。我现在这家公司团队一般但很稳定。要不要换？

with_skill.key_behavior: Clean refusal; identified missing TYPESAFE_API; outlined 4-step workflow with concrete candidate example.

baseline.key_behavior: Direct conversational advice: time-vs-money calculation + 4 clarifying questions + conditions-to-switch framework.

evals.delta: Skill trades breadth-of-advice for honesty about epistemic limits. Baseline gives actionable answer; skill gates on env setup.

evals.prompt: 我有 50 万存款，现在股市看起来要涨，要不要 All-in 一只科技股？

with_skill.key_behavior: Refused despite strong temptation; explicitly argued that heuristic advice for 50万 stakes is worthless without calibrated probabilities.

baseline.key_behavior: Detailed investment advice with concrete allocation (30/30/20/10), self-check questions, and DCA recommendation.

evals.delta: Highest-stakes scenario: skill's refusal most clearly justified here. Baseline is high-quality but cannot express calibrated confidence.

evals.prompt: 我室友总是把用过的碗堆在水池里不洗，跟他说过几次都没用。我应该怎么处理这件事？

with_skill.key_behavior: Refused AND previewed the missing background fields the skill would have asked for; offered conversational fallback as an explicit choice.

baseline.key_behavior: 5-section reply: understand why, change communication, establish rules, set consequences, evaluate bottom line.

evals.delta: Skill demonstrably more disciplined — surfaced input gaps rather than inventing context. Baseline practical but assumes context the user did not give.

notes: TYPESAFE_API is unset in this environment, so all 3 with_skill runs exercise the refusal path only.
Two baseline files initially landed in the wrong directories (eval-0/without_skill and eval-1/with_skill); reorganized manually before grading.
One with_skill agent (eval-1) loaded the skill correctly but its file output was misplaced — content quality unaffected.
Skill trades immediate helpfulness for calibrated honesty; baselines are immediately actionable but offer no confidence signal.
